Checked 2026-11-24 against the official ENR 3.1/3.3/4.1/4.4 of the 2026-10-01 edition: W1 gives AC (An Loc NDB) but no point `BU`, and R468 ends at TAN SON NHAT (TSH) in the Vietnamese AIP, so PNH (Phnom Penh, AIP Cambodia) has no official Vietnamese coordinates; the runway-relative line and "parallel" extents are also undefined. Not reconstructed]
